def test_strange_sort_list():
    # Basic alternating min/max sort
    assert strange_sort_list([1, 2, 3, 4]) == [1, 4, 2, 3]
    assert strange_sort_list([5, 5, 5, 5]) == [5, 5, 5, 5]

    # Edge cases
    assert strange_sort_list([]) == []
    assert strange_sort_list([7]) == [7]
    assert strange_sort_list([1, 2]) == [1, 2]

    # Unsorted input
    assert strange_sort_list([3, 1, 4, 1, 5, 9, 2, 6]) == [1, 9, 1, 6, 2, 5, 3, 4]

    # Already sorted / reverse sorted
    assert strange_sort_list([1, 2, 3]) == [1, 3, 2]
    assert strange_sort_list([3, 2, 1]) == [1, 3, 2]

    assert strange_sort_list([-1, -5, -3]) == [-5, -1, -3]

    snapshot = list(original)
    strange_sort_list(original)
    assert original == snapshot

if __name__ == "__main__":
